scopeAndNamingChecks.factualDifference: The historian describes the present Tarján housing estate using Lugas/Csillag/Retek/József Attila/Murányi/Körtöltés, with specified house-number-side differences. That differs from the official IVS Debreceni-road footprint. We do not combine them or assert identical extents.
scopeAndNamingChecks.supports: Tarján remains a named quarter; the IVS circuit is a source-era extent rather than independently verified current estate extent.

scopeAndNamingChecks.factualDifference: The municipal concept describes the Római/Szilléri/Debreceni/József Attila four-road area as suburban/garden construction, while describing panel estate farther out. This conflicts with the numbered2017 IVS subdivision label. The small circuit is retained only as historical planning evidence.
